results.name: First run: passphrase rules, vault creation, one-time recovery code
1. Add a task in seconds (type + Return)
2. Add a task without a time
3. Add a task with start and end in one line
Quick add understands "tomorrow" and can be ignored
4. Arabic-Indic digits become 123 (typing, pasting, saved data)
5. Change a task time (10:00-style edit) without recreating it
Overlapping times are flagged quietly, not blocked
6. Move a task to tomorrow
7. Mark done, then not done (one tap each, no confirmation)
Delete with undo
8. Close and reopen: data is still there, no passphrase asked
Second device: wrong passphrase rejected, right one unlocks once
9. Edit on iPhone → appears on laptop, and back
10. Same task edited on both devices: no silent loss
11. Offline: keeps working, says so calmly, syncs when back
Closing the page before it could sync loses nothing
Earlier open tasks are offered, never moved automatically
12. Arabic RTL and English LTR
13. Small iPhone, 320px, dark mode and laptop layouts
Laptop keyboard: n focuses the composer, arrows change day, Esc closes
Recovery code: forgot passphrase on a new device
Export a plain copy through the download capability
14. No notifications and no permission prompts
15. Server holds ciphertext only
16. No third-party requests, no errors, no task content in logs
